'''Condaker Blathos''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], where he was a resident of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]]. Blathos was a member of the [[Intarsa League]], a criminal faction led by the [[Force Adept]] [[Dersa Welles]] and circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] he accompanied the League on a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] journey to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to meet with the Rodian [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] [[Roos Londabir]] to setup a shell company. However, the shuttle was attacked by an unknown rival en-route and crash-landed on the Cularin surface. Blathos was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the impact and his corpse was subsequently discovered by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
